items.title: Ph.D. Positions Available | Shenzhen University, China
items.description:
We are recruiting two Ph.D. students to join the research group of Dr. Xinxu Zhang at Shenzhen University. This is an excellent opportunity for motivated candidates passionate about microbiology, immunology, bioinformatics, and environmental science.
📌 Eligibility
Master’s degree (or above) in Microbiology, Immunology, Bioinformatics, Aquaculture, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Environmental Science
Applicants under 40 years of age
Expected graduation certificate accepted (official diploma required before enrollment)
🔬 Research Directions
Deep‑sea microorganisms in carbon & nitrogen biogeochemical cycles
Immune interactions between aquatic invertebrates and microbiomes
Isolation & cultivation of novel archaea and bacteria
Development of probiotics and bioactive substances
💰 Salary & Benefits
Annual salary: 65,000 RMB (~USD 9,330)
Generous scholarships offered after research article publication
📩 How to Apply
Send applications to: rrathour@szu.edu.cn
Priority for candidates ready to begin Ph.D. studies promptly
